title: Union Budget since 2014-15: money that was budgeted but not spent, line by line
summary: Every year Parliament is asked to vote thousands of crores for each scheme, body and department. We go through 12 financial years, 2014-15 to 2025-26: 19,208 budget lines from 1,162 official Notes on Demands for Grants statements. No investigative work: each check reads the budget estimate, the revised estimate and the actual expenditure that the Ministry of Finance itself printed, and reports the part that was not spent. 10,000 checks, each verified by three independent agents.
authority: Ministry of Finance (Union Budget) and the Union ministries and departments that hold each Demand for Grants
scope: Every numbered line of section A of the Notes on Demands for Grants, for every Demand and Appropriation of the Union Government: schemes, autonomous bodies, establishment heads and transfers to States.
The budget estimate and the revised estimate of a financial year, read from the Union Budget presented one year later, where both are printed on one row.
The actual expenditure of that year, read from the Union Budget presented two years later (14,679 lines traced so far by printed name and by the figure both budgets print for the year in between).

How much of each line's budget estimate was not spent, and how much of that was already dropped at the revised-estimate stage. A line is reported when 10% or more of its budget estimate, and at least Rs 1 crore, was not spent.
The 8,322 largest lines (budget estimate of Rs 98.26 crore or more) get a check each; smaller lines of one Demand and year share a check, up to 10 at a time.
Only statements whose numbered lines add up to their printed Grand Total in all four periods are used.
out_of_scope: Any individual officer, employee or beneficiary.
Investigations, leaked or non-public records, RTI replies and anything behind a login.
Why money was not spent: the check reports printed figures, and lists the ordinary reasons, not a cause.
Money released to States and implementing agencies that stayed unspent with them. The Union's accounts count it as spent on release; it is listed below as planned work.
Repayment of debt (the rolling over of treasury bills and loans), which is not money voted to be spent.
Actual expenditure for 2025-26, printed only in Union Budget 2027-28 (February 2027). Those 1,514 lines are checked against the revised estimate for now.
Most 2015-16 lines after the revised-estimate stage: Union Budget 2017-18 dropped the Plan and Non-Plan split and regrouped the schemes, so their actuals cannot be traced by name.
